data.title: NVIDIA’s $3 Billion Bet on the Power Behind AI
data.description: NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA)’s latest push into the infrastructure supporting AI chips extends all the way to the power grid. According to a report from The Information, published on August 7, NVIDIA will spend up to $3 billion in Lancium, a power infrastructure developer and the firm behind the Stargate data center project in Abilene, Texas.
